name: Show Marquee - Output
description: Turn the whole sign on or off and save it (the Output enabled switch on the Display tab). Off blanks the matrix and turns the overlay model off, so sequences show through; the pages keep their own switches, so On brings back the same rotation. Use it from the scheduler to turn the sign off for the night.

args.name: State
args.help: On shows the pages, Off blanks the sign, Toggle switches to the opposite of the current state.

name: Show Marquee - Countdown
description: Turn the countdown page on or off and save it (its Show on the matrix switch). The other pages keep taking turns; with every page off the matrix goes blank and the overlay model turns off, so sequences show through.

args.name: State
args.help: On shows the countdown, Off hides it, Toggle switches to the opposite of the current state.

name: Show Marquee - Set Target
description: Change what the countdown counts down to, and save it.

args.name: Target
args.help: Christmas (Dec 25) and New Year's Day (Jan 1) use their own dates; Custom uses the date below.

args.name: Date
args.help: Only for Custom, e.g. 2027-03-14. Leave empty to keep the date already saved.

args.name: Time
args.help: Only for Custom, e.g. 18:30. Leave empty to keep the time already saved (00:00 if none).

args.name: Name
args.help: The name shown in the message, e.g. Opening Night. Leave empty to keep the saved name for this target.

args.name: Repeat
args.help: Only for Custom. Empty keeps the saved setting.

name: Show Marquee - Start
description: Start Show Marquee's background program if it isn't running (the settings page's Start button uses this). It starts with FPP on its own; this is for after a Stop.
